risks.description: S=R=1 forbidden state mapped deterministically to Q=0. Real NOR latch race behavior not simulated. This is a known model simplification.
VHDL concurrent NOR assignments form a combinational feedback loop. VHDL simulators may require delta-cycle resolution. Some synthesis tools will refuse or warn.
Asynchronous feedback loop. The simulation engine processes this gate in topological order but SR_LATCH is inherently cyclic. Engine handles this via iterative re-evaluation up to cycle limit.
